metadata.title: Chapter 11: Constructions
metadata.subtitle: The Ultimate Board Exam Mastery Guide
metadata.subject: Maths
metadata.author: Antigravity Supreme Intelligence
learning_outcomes: Master the division of a line segment in a given ratio.
Construct a triangle similar to a given triangle.
Construct tangents to a circle from an external point.
Write perfect steps of construction for board exams.

ai_context.learning_goal: Make constructions intuitive and precise. Explain 'why' each step works instead of just 'how' to do it.
common_misconceptions: Students forget to write the steps of construction or justification.
Students get confused with the scale factor (proper vs improper fraction).

blocks.content: Have you ever wondered how architects draw perfectly scaled blueprints for skyscrapers or bridges? They use the power of geometric constructions! In this chapter, all you need is a compass, a ruler, and the logic of similar triangles to create perfect geometrical shapes.
The Architect's Tools: Compass, Ruler, and Pencil.
blocks.alt_text: An image showing geometry box tools like compass, ruler, and pencil.

blocks.content:
**Division of a Line Segment (रेखाखंड का विभाजन):**
To divide a line segment AB in a given ratio m:n, we draw a ray AX making an acute angle with AB, then locate m+n points at equal distances on AX. We join the last point to B, and draw a line parallel to it from the m-th point to intersect AB.
💡 **Teacher's Secret:** The justification for dividing a line segment lies in **Thales Theorem (Basic Proportionality Theorem)**. The parallel lines create similar triangles!

**Constructing a Similar Triangle:**
When constructing a triangle similar to a given triangle, the **scale factor (m/n)** decides the size.
- If m/n < 1, the new triangle is **smaller** (inside the original).
- If m/n > 1, the new triangle is **larger** (outside the original).
Visualizing scale factors: Smaller vs Larger similar triangles.
blocks.alt_text: Diagram showing two sets of similar triangles, one scaled down and one scaled up.

blocks.content:
**Steps of Construction: Tangents from an External Point (बाह्य बिंदु से स्पर्श रेखाएँ):**
Let the circle have center O, and P be an external point.
1. Join PO and bisect it. Let M be the midpoint of PO.
2. Taking M as center and MO as radius, draw a circle. Let it intersect the given circle at points Q and R.
3. Join PQ and PR. Then PQ and PR are the required two tangents.

*Justification:* The angle in a semi-circle is a right angle. Since PQ is perpendicular to the radius OQ, PQ must be a tangent!

🔥 **BOARD EXAM HOT TOPIC:** Steps of Construction and Justification

*Board Trick:* Examiners don't just look at your drawing! You MUST write the steps clearly and often provide the geometric justification. Always keep your pencil sharp and draw neat arcs. Don't erase the construction arcs!

blocks.question: The length of an arc of a sector of angle θ (in degrees) of a circle with radius r is:
blocks.question_hi: r त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के θ कोण वाले त्रिज्यखंड के संगत चाप की लंबाई है:
blocks.explanation: The length of the arc is proportional to the angle of the sector. Arc length = (θ/360) × 2πr.
blocks.explanation_hi: चाप की लंबाई त्रिज्यखंड के कोण के समानुपाती होती है। चाप की लंबाई = (θ/360) × 2πr।

blocks.question: Area of a sector of angle p (in degrees) of a circle with radius R is:
blocks.question_hi: R त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के p (डिग्री में) कोण वाले त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल है:
blocks.explanation: Area = (p/360) × πR², which can be written as (p/720) × 2πR².
blocks.explanation_hi: क्षेत्रफल = (p/360) × πR², जिसे (p/720) × 2πR² के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है।

blocks.question: The area of a circle that can be inscribed in a square of side 6 cm is:
blocks.question_hi: 6 सेमी भुजा वाले वर्ग के अंतर्गत खींचे जा सकने वाले वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल है:
blocks.explanation: Diameter of the circle = side of the square = 6 cm. Radius = 3 cm. Area = π(3)² = 9π cm².
blocks.explanation_hi: वृत्त का व्यास = वर्ग की भुजा = 6 सेमी। त्रिज्या = 3 सेमी। क्षेत्रफल = π(3)² = 9π सेमी²।

blocks.question: The area of the square that can be inscribed in a circle of radius 8 cm is:
blocks.question_hi: 8 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के अंतर्गत खींचे जा सकने वाले वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल है:
blocks.explanation: Diagonal of the square = diameter of circle = 16 cm. Area = (1/2) × d² = (1/2)(16)² = 128 cm².
blocks.explanation_hi: वर्ग का विकर्ण = वृत्त का व्यास = 16 सेमी। क्षेत्रफल = (1/2) × d² = (1/2) × 16² = 128 सेमी²।

blocks.question: A wheel has diameter 84 cm. Find how many complete revolutions must it take to cover 792 metres. (Take π = 22/7)
blocks.question_hi: एक पहिये का व्यास 84 सेमी है। 792 मीटर की दूरी तय करने के लिए इसे कितने पूरे चक्कर लगाने होंगे? (π = 22/7 लें)
blocks.explanation: Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × 42 = 264 cm = 2.64 m. Number of revolutions = 792 / 2.64 = 300.

blocks.question: The area of the circle that can be inscribed in a hexagon of side a is:
blocks.question_hi: a भुजा वाले समषट्भुज के अंतर्गत खींचे जा सकने वाले वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल है:
blocks.explanation: The inscribed circle touches the midpoints of the sides. Its radius is the altitude of the equilateral triangle of side a, i.e., r = (√3/2)a. Area = πr² = 3πa²/4.
blocks.explanation_hi: अंतर्वृत्त भुजाओं के मध्यबिंदुओं को स्पर्श करता है। इसकी त्रिज्या a भुजा वाले समबाहु त्रिभुज की ऊंचाई है, अर्थात r = (√3/2)a। क्षेत्रफल = πr² = 3πa²/4।

blocks.question: A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the centre. The area of the minor segment is: (Use π = 3.14)
blocks.question_hi: 10 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की एक जीवा केंद्र पर समकोण अंतरित करती है। संगत लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल है: (π = 3.14 का प्रयोग करें)
blocks.explanation: Area of sector = (90/360) × 3.14 × 10² = 78.5. Area of triangle = (1/2) × 10 × 10 = 50. Area of segment = 78.5 - 50 = 28.5 cm².

blocks.question: A cow is tied with a rope of length 14 m at the corner of a rectangular field of dimensions 20m × 16m. The area of the field in which the cow can graze is:
blocks.question_hi: एक गाय को 20 मीटर × 16 मीटर विमाओं वाले एक आयताकार खेत के कोने पर 14 मीटर लंबी रस्सी से बांधा गया है। खेत का वह क्षेत्रफल जिसमें गाय चर सकती है, है:
blocks.explanation: The area grazed is a quadrant of a circle of radius 14 m. Area = (1/4) × π × 14² = (1/4) × (22/7) × 196 = 154 m².
blocks.explanation_hi: चरा गया क्षेत्रफल 14 मीटर त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त का एक चतुर्थांश है। क्षेत्रफल = 1/4 × π × 14² = 1/4 × 22/7 × 196 = 154 मी²।
